transcript.prompt: Solve x² + 6x = 7 visually by completing the square.

patch.narration: We will solve x squared plus six x equals seven by turning the left side into an area.

presentation.checkpointNarration: We will solve x squared plus six x equals seven by turning the left side into an area.

patch.narration: The x squared term is a square, while six x is represented as two equal three x strips.

presentation.checkpointNarration: The x squared term is a square, while six x is represented as two equal three x strips.

presentationCheckpoint.checkpointNarration: The x squared term is a square, while six x is represented as two equal three x strips.

patch.narration: Splitting six x evenly gives three x plus three x, one strip for each adjacent side.

presentation.checkpointNarration: Splitting six x evenly gives three x plus three x, one strip for each adjacent side.

patch.narration: A three-by-three corner has area nine, so add nine to both sides: the right side becomes sixteen.

presentation.checkpointNarration: A three-by-three corner has area nine, so add nine to both sides: the right side becomes sixteen.

presentationCheckpoint.checkpointNarration: A three-by-three corner has area nine, so add nine to both sides: the right side becomes sixteen.
